articles.title: Bhutan: the last place

articles.title: Other people
articles.summary:
• Disconnection permeates modern life, fueling personal and societal crises that demand urgent attention.  
• Embracing communal living serves as a profound antidote to isolation, fostering deeper connections among individuals.  
• The act of sharing space and resources challenges conventional notions of independence and self-sufficiency.  
• Communal living invites introspection, revealing the complexities of human relationships and the need for vulnerability.  
• In a world increasingly defined by individualism, the choice to live together becomes a radical act of hope and solidarity.
